channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Mullahoran turn to Fallon
item.description: Former Mayo All-Star midfielder Pat Fallon will take the Mullahoran senior football reins next year.

item.title: Armagh suffer Grimley blow
item.description: Armagh are set to be without Niall Grimley for the early part of their 2026 campaign.

item.title: O'Connor back at Geelong
item.description: Fresh from winning a Munster club SFC medal with Dingle last Sunday week, Mark O'Connor is settling back into pre-season training with his AFL club Geelong.

item.title: Corrigan takes charge of Clonguish
item.description: Former Fermanagh and Sligo boss Dominic Corrigan has been appointed as the new manager of Longford senior football side Clonguish.

item.title: Beggan draws praise from all quarters
item.description: Rival managers David McCague and Martin Corey heaped praise on Rory Beggan after his heroics in Saturday night's Ulster club SFC final.

item.title: Kelly retires from Kildare duty
item.description: Kildare stalwart Niall Kelly has announced his retirement from inter-county football.

item.title: Ladies proposal to trial 12 playing rule enhancements ratified by Central Council
item.description: The Ladies Gaelic Football Association has confirmed that a package of 12 playing rule enhancementswill be trialled during the 2026 Lidl National Football League season and Higher Education Colleges competitions.

item.title: Dr. Harty Cup History Book launched
item.description: The first ever history of the Dr. Harty Cup, which has been contested annually since 1918 has been launched.

item.title: All-Ireland Club football semi-final fixtures details revealed
item.description: The GAA has announced the times, dates and venues for the All-Ireland Club football semi-finals.

item.title: McBrearty retires from Donegal duty
item.description: Donegal captain Paddy McBrearty has announced his retirement from intercounty football.
